decision.title: Order payment details
decision.question: Order.payment is a card (last4, brand) or a bank account (iban). How much of it should the subgraph expose?
decision.context: Recommendation: hide-iban. A full IBAN is financial personal data; last4 and brand are already masked by the API.

choices.label: Expose card last4/brand and bank iban
Expose card last4/brand and the payment type; hide iban
